name: TGG Public API
description:
The API manages events for experts and provides public access to event information.

## Features
- Retrieve events by API key
- Filter events by date range (startDate, endDate). By default startDate is now, and endDate 30 days from now.
- Filter events by type (SINGLE, PROGRAM, RECURRING). By Default is returning all.
- Filter events by status (CONFIRMED, PENDING, CANCELLED). By default is returning the CONFIRMED ones.
- Formatted response with event details in CST timezone
